title: Farming Gold... Vegetables
description: Farming Gold... Vegetables — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Yakov Smearnov

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 5 Golded Pumpkins and 15 Golded Ears o' Corn from the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Yakov Smearnov

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 5 Golded Pumpkins and 15 Golded Ears o' Corn from the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

At the root of our problems right now is the golded vegetables. They present a real problem for us. This matter has split the Dungeon Runners down the middle, with half of them opposing the sale of the golded veggies to other Dungeon Runners and the other half chomping at the bit to buy as much as they can to help them get ahead of the curve. Some people want to earn their stripes and some just wish to buy them, hey this is Dungeon Runners! We should just offer some golded vegetables as micro-transactions... whatever that is.

I'm getting away from what is important, my apologies. The real task at hand is to find a way to turn the farms back to normal and to do this we need samples of the vegetables. Locate the farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and collect the golded vegetables there. When you have the required amount return to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

Good. Good. I see you have quite a gold thumb. Ha! Get it! Let me know if you would like to do this quest again.

Objectives:

  • Golded Pumpkins ×5
  • Golded Ears o' Corn ×15

Level range: 75–100
